title: WPMS/624/2015 of Shri Guru Nanak Shiksha Samiti AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 624 of 2015 (M/S)
Shri Guru Nanak Shiksha Samiti
and another .....Petitioners
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ....Respondents
Mr. Pankaj Purohit, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Syed Nadim, Standing Counsel for respondent Nos. 1 to 5.
Mr. A.D. Tripathi, Advocate for the Caveator / Intervenor.
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J. (Oral)
Present petition is preferred assailing the order
dated 13.02.2015, annexure No. 12 to the writ petition,
whereby Additional Director of Education (Secondary
Education), Kumaon Mandal, Nainital was pleased to
appoint Administrator in the institution, in question.
Undisputedly, Shri Guru Nanak Girls Inter
College, Rudrapur is a minority institution; vide order
dated 18th August, 2008, Joint Director of Education
was pleased to point out certain defects in the Scheme of
Administration; Writ Petition No. 1580 of 2009 (M/S),
filed by the present petitioners was disposed of vide
judgment dated 26.06.2014 directing the petitioners to
cure defects as pointed by the Joint Director of
Education vide order dated 18th August, 2008 in the
Scheme of Administration within three days; it was
further directed on curing of the defects, no adverse
action is required to be taken against the petitioners on
the ground of non-submission of fresh Scheme of
Administration.
Perusal of the impugned order would reveal that
although in compliance of the judgment dated
26.06.2014, passed by this Court, copy of the scheme of
administration curing the defects, was furnished before

2
the Education Authorities, however, Scheme of
Administration submitted under the signature of the
then Manger was not accepted saying it was signed by
the Manager whose tenure stood expired on 26.06.2014
and Dr. P.N. Singh, District Education Officer
(Secondary Education), Udham Singh Nagar was
appointed as Administrator for next six months or till
the next Management of Committee is elected. Feeling
aggrieved, petitioners have once again approached this
Court.
Perusal of Clause 7 of the Scheme of
Administration (page No. 67 of the paper book), would
reveal that although tenure of the elected Management
Committee shall be three years from the date of election,
however, same Management Committee shall be
enforced / shall continue till the next management
committee is elected.
Thus, observation made in the impugned order
that tenure of Manager stood expired on 26.06.2014 is
against the mandate of Clause 7 of the Scheme of
Administration.
It is nowhere stated in the impugned order that
defects have not been removed / cured as yet as directed
by this Court vide judgment dated 26th June, 2014,
passed in WPMS No. 1580 of 2009.
There is another aspect of the matter. As per sub-section (14) of Section 34 of the Uttaranchal School
Education Act, 2006, nothing contained in sub-section
(3) to (13) shall apply to institutions established and
administered by a minority referred to in Clause (1) of
Article 30 of the Constitution of India. Since,
admittedly, Guru Nanak Girls Inter College, Rudrapur /

3
petitioner No. 2 is a minority institution, being
administered by the Sikh Community, therefore, as per
sub-section (14) of Section 34 of the Act, it is beyond the
power and jurisdiction of the Education Authority to
appoint Administrator to run and manage the minority
education institution.
In my humble opinion, as per Clause 7 of the
Scheme of Administration as referred above, tenure of
the Management Committee shall remain in force till
the new election are held, therefore, observations in the
impugned order that Scheme of Administration after
curing the defects has submitted under the signature of
old Manager, does not hold water. However, I am of
the further view that for the better / proper
administration and management of the Minority
Institution/ petitioner No. 2, election should be held
ordinarily within the time prescribed or soon thereafter.
Present petition thus succeeds and is hereby
allowed. Impugned order is quashed. However,
election of the Management Committee of the
petitioners shall be held preferably within 30 days from
today for which last elected Management Committee
shall take appropriate steps preferably within a week.
No order as to cost.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 19th March, 2015 Shiv
